definitions.explanation: A round neckline sitting close to the base of the neck, on T-shirts, sweaters and other tops; also a garment with one.

examples.japanese: {丸首|まるくび}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦セーター→セーター：01371_seetaa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}た→着る：00541_kiru⟧。
examples.english: I put on a crew-neck sweater.

examples.japanese: ⟦{首|くび}→首：00792_kubi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{長|なが}く→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{丸首|まるくび}⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧Vネック⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ほう⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧だ。
examples.english: I prefer V-necks to round necks, because they make my neck look longer.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{丸|まる}→丸：02167_maru⟧ (round) + ⟦{首|くび}→首：00792_kubi⟧ (neck). The English loan クルーネック means the same and is common in shop listings.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {丸首|まるくび}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧Tシャツ: a round-neck T-shirt
- {丸首|まるくび}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦セーター→セーター：01371_seetaa⟧: a crew-neck sweater

SIMILAR WORDS:
- Vネック: V-neck
- ⟦タートルネック→タートルネック：27713_taatorunekku⟧: turtleneck
